theme_cn: 作文跟读 + 合成代词语法 + 听力 + KET词汇 + 背默作文 + 键盘拼写
writing_name: 背诵作文 · 写给朋友的邮件

grammar.question: 选词填空（anyone / anybody / anything / anywhere / everyone / everything / nothing / someone / somewhere）：___ called you this afternoon, but I cannot remember his name.
grammar.explanation_cn: 肯定句里用 some- 开头的词：someone 某人。答案敲小写 someone 就行。

grammar.question: 选词填空（anyone / anybody / anything / anywhere / everyone / everything / nothing / someone / somewhere）：I cannot find my dog ___.
grammar.explanation_cn: 否定句（cannot）里用 any- 开头的词：anywhere 任何地方，哪儿都找不到。

grammar.question: 选词填空（anyone / anybody / anything / anywhere / everyone / everything / nothing / someone / somewhere）：The little girl is running on the playground by herself; she does not run with ___.
grammar.explanation_cn: 她自己一个人跑，不和任何人一起跑 → 否定意思用 anybody。

grammar.question: 选词填空（anyone / anybody / anything / anywhere / everyone / everything / nothing / someone / somewhere）：Just relax, you cannot finish ___ at the same time.
grammar.explanation_cn: cannot finish everything = 不可能一次把所有事都做完。

grammar.question: 选词填空（anyone / anybody / anything / anywhere / everyone / everything / nothing / someone / somewhere）：All the students are having class now, so ___ is here.
grammar.explanation_cn: 所有人都到齐了 → 肯定句用 everyone 每个人。

listening.question: Listen to the dialogue. Which line goes to the city museum?
listening.audio_text: Woman: Excuse me, which line goes to the city museum? Man: Line Two, and the museum is the third stop. Woman: Thank you very much.
listening.explanation_cn: 男士说 Line Two（二号线），the third stop 是「第三站」，不是三号线。

listening.question: Listen to the dialogue. How will the girl go to school today?
listening.audio_text: Dad: The road is busy this morning, so we will take the subway. Girl: Good idea, it is faster than the bus. Dad: We need to change at the next station.
listening.explanation_cn: 爸爸说 we will take the subway（我们坐地铁），因为地铁比公交车快。

listening.question: Which picture matches the sentence you hear?
listening.audio_text: Many people are waiting for the train on the platform.
listening.explanation_cn: 句子里说 waiting for the train on the platform（在站台等地铁），所以选 🚇。

listening.question: Listen and fill in the blank: Please stand behind the yellow ___.
listening.audio_text: Please stand behind the yellow line and let the people get off first.
listening.explanation_cn: 听到 stand behind the yellow line（站在黄线后面），所以填 line。

ket_pet.question: KET: I made an ___ with Mark to go fishing on Saturday.
ket_pet.explanation_cn: make an appointment with sb. 是固定搭配「和某人约定」；an 后面接元音开头的 appointment。

ket_pet.question: KET: Tom told me his parents had arrived ___ Beijing.
ket_pet.explanation_cn: arrive in + 大地方（城市、国家），arrive at + 小地点。北京是大城市，用 arrive in Beijing。

ket_pet.question: KET: Uncle Lee usually spends his summer holiday in the rural ___.
ket_pet.explanation_cn: rural area 是固定说法「乡村地区」；area 指一片区域。

ket_pet.question: KET: A room for taking a shower is called a ___.
ket_pet.explanation_cn: bath 是洗澡，bathroom = 浴室；bedroom 睡觉，classroom 上课，kitchen 做饭。

ket_pet.question: KET: A ___ is a person who helps you with your work.
ket_pet.explanation_cn: assist 是「帮助」，assistant = 助手/店员，是帮你干活的人。

writing.title: Dear Lucy（四线三格作文 · 全文背默）
writing.requirement_cn: 先把整封信大声读三遍，再把 5 个空填好，最后背诵全文。这封短信就是本周要背熟的作文！
writing.template: Dear Lucy, I am so happy to go {{1}} with you tomorrow. We can meet at your {{2}}. Is 10 o'clock OK? Then we can take a {{3}}. I want to buy new {{4}} boots and some pairs of {{5}}. See you tomorrow!
writing.full_text_cn: 亲爱的Lucy，明天能和你一起去购物我太开心了。我们可以在你家碰面。10点钟行吗？然后我们可以打出租车去。我想买新足球鞋和几双袜子。明天见！
writing.explanation_cn: 英文书信三要素：称呼 Dear Lucy 开头、正文说清「和谁、几点、干什么」、结尾 See you tomorrow! 加署名 Tom。go shopping 去购物；meet at your home 在你家碰面（小地点用 at）；take a taxi 打车；a pair of socks 一双袜子，两双就是 two pairs of socks。
writing.explanation_en: A short note needs a greeting (Dear Lucy), the plan (when, where, what), and a closing (See you tomorrow!) with the name Tom.

spell.question: 约定；预约：a___________ [填完整单词]
spell.explanation_cn: appoint + ment；make an appointment with sb. 和某人约好。

spell.question: 地区：a___ [填完整单词]
spell.explanation_cn: area 读 /ˈeəriə/，三个字母 a、r、e 加一个 a，别漏掉结尾的 a。

spell.question: 足球鞋：b____ [填完整单词]
spell.explanation_cn: boot 加 s；一双靴子 a pair of boots，作文里是 football boots。

writing_drill.title: 第 5~6 句 · 重点句冲刺
writing_drill.focus_cn: buy new football boots 是最长的一句，放慢读；See you tomorrow! 读出开心的语气收尾

sentences.en: I want to buy new football boots and some pairs of socks.
sentences.cn: 我想买新足球鞋和几双袜子。
